• Mid Length: the classic all-round option, with the most traditional coverage.
• Swim & Wear: the most tailored option, designed to work both as swim shorts and as a polished summer short.

After swimming, rinse them with fresh water and let them air dry. If you wash them, use cold water and a mild detergent. Blanc Mid Length is still the easiest first pick if you want to keep it simple.
